about: The nine cameras of the screenshots the author put in the folder 'Visual Bugs' on 2026-11-04, each found by matching the screenshot against renders of the same place (zero-mean normalised cross-correlation of the edge images over a range of scales: the peak gives the zoom and the world pixel in the middle of the screenshot). `world` is that pixel (sx, sy of a grid point at its height); `zoom` is 0.57 to 0.63 throughout, at density 2; `hour` is the clock hour the shot is lit for (the author's clock ran about seven seconds an hour, so the shots were taken at about 17, 18.5, 19.5, then night and dawn); `lite` is the governor's tier 3 (no small props below zoom 0.6, no swash), which is what the author's browser was in for the shots without lamps and lookout decks; `crop` is the screenshot's size in device pixels, cut from the middle of the canvas. `defects` are the road defect classes of scripts/lib/road-audit.mjs that show in the picture. scripts/world-author-shots.mjs draws them; docs/RENDER_PLAN.md says how to use it. The images themselves stay out of the repository.

cameras.what: Creative Quarter, its north corner: a locked road with no dashes, a road with dashes forking from it, a plateau edge, a cliff, pink ground
Creative Quarter, the east end of its avenue: the road stops at the edge of the block, a tan footpath leaves it across an empty pad
Creative Quarter whole: a flat plateau with a hard edge, empty maroon yards, LIVE banners and dishes scattered round it, two roads and a footpath leaving
Farmland Co-op with the road to Creative (left) and to Tech (right): silos dotted over the fields, an empty dark lot, a footpath that ends in grass, two cars
Tech Corridor, west side: a footpath laid over the road at its port, dishes on bare ground, a big empty pad
Industrial Park, south: a footpath that runs to a cliff top and ends, tanks and stacks on bare ground
Harbor Docks, west port: two roads merge into one as they enter the yard, containers on bare pad
Campus Quad, south west: an empty lawn quad, a footpath that rounds it to a deck, the road to a bridge; the pale sheet of the swash bug (fixed on the branch claude/night-lag-and-veil)
Pawn District, east port: two roads and a footpath leave one port, the footpath laid over the road, a hard-edged plateau
